criteria.justification: The answer deliberately avoids naming any schema elements, stating "I don't want to guess or invent details about a schema I can't see," so no fabricated fields, types, or directives appear.
It only restates the question ("Whether cancelling/placing an order requires authentication") without stating that both require CUSTOMER-role authentication.
No ProductFilter fields are listed; the answer merely lists "What fields products can be filtered by" as an unanswered question.
The answer does not mention productPriceChanged or its lack of arguments, only the unanswered question about a price-change subscription.
No mention of PlaceOrderInput, productIds, shipTo, payWith, or identity coming from the authenticated context.
PaymentInput, @oneOf, and the three token/code options are never mentioned.
The answer never identifies Customer.email or the STAFF role restriction, only asking whether "any customer fields are restricted."
